name: rows
title: Plant Rows Analysis
subtitle: Row spacing, canopy cover, and plant density
description: Quantifies plant row characteristics: spacing, canopy cover%, and plants per row. Detects rows via projection profile peaks and analyzes canopy via ExG (excess green index).
method: ExG threshold (2G−R−B) → per-row ROI via projection-profile peaks → area measurement. Robust to LED color casts.
dataType: overhead row images (plants in neat rows, good contrast)

outputs.name: CanopyCover
outputs.label: Canopy cover
outputs.description: Fraction of image occupied by green foliage

outputs.name: PlantsPerRow
outputs.label: Mean plants per row
outputs.description: Number of plant clusters detected per row

parameters.name: exgThreshold
parameters.label: ExG threshold
parameters.description: Green-channel threshold. Higher = less sensitive to shadows.

parameters.name: minRowHeight
parameters.label: Minimum row height
parameters.description: Rows narrower than this are ignored (noise).
